test: Hankel/Stieltjes moment test for Li coefficients (Track 1)
verdict: FAILS at N=2 — (lambda_n) is NOT a moment sequence
note: H_2=[[l1,l2],[l2,l3]] not PD since l1*l3 < l2^2. Sequence is log-concave, opposite of moment requirement. Moment-sequence route to RH is dead. Does NOT contradict RH (which only needs lambda_n>0, verified).
